verdict.rationale: The docs show account-based sign-in (`--device-auth` device-code authentication), but nothing documents a free tier. Community reports say access at launch was gated to SuperGrok Heavy subscribers, and a $40/month subscriber could not get past the login prompt. The sign-in mechanism alone does not deliver the story's core promise of free-tier access.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign in with a personal account to get free-tier access without managing API keys
